episodes.title: #020 The Mysterious Marys?
episodes.short: #020 The Mysterious Marys?
episodes.description: For centuries Catholics have wondered about the relationship between Mary Magdalene and Mary the sister of Martha and Lazarus. Many have said that they were the same person. But according to the Vatican, new studies have finally figured this issue out. What do these new studies reveal? And what impact have they had on the Church’s calendar? Jimmy Akin explains.

episodes.title: #019 Wes Huff—Adding or Deleting Books from the Bible? - Jimmy Akin
episodes.short: #019 Wes Huff—Adding or Deleting Books from the Bible? - Jimmy Akin
episodes.description: Wes Huff is a young Protestant apologist who has recently had a lot of success. He has admirable qualities, and he does better than many other Protestant apologists do.In this video, Jimmy Akin—in a friendly spirit of “iron sharpens iron” (Prov. 27:17)—take a look at both some of Wes’s strong points and his weak points, particularly when it comes to his knowledge of how the biblical canon was formed.

episodes.title: #018 “Jesus Wept” - Jimmy Akin
episodes.short: #018 “Jesus Wept” - Jimmy Akin
episodes.description: The shortest verse in the Bible is just two words: “Jesus wept” (John 11:35).Despite how short it is, this verse contains important lessons for all of us—both lessons about who Jesus was and lessons that we can apply in our own lives in times of crisis. Join Jimmy Akin as he explores the mysteries of the shortest verse in the Bible.

episodes.title: #017 Can Mary Hear Your Prayers? - Jimmy Akin
episodes.short: #017 Can Mary Hear Your Prayers? - Jimmy Akin
episodes.description: Protestant apologist James White recently declared that “Mary has no power on earth, has no idea you, or anyone else is praying to her, and hence that would be an utter waste of time and breath.”But former Protestant Jimmy Akin says that he would have questioned this claim even when he was still a Protestant.Why would Jimmy do that? What biblical reasons would he cite? And what does the evidence—even from a Protestant point of view—have to say?

episodes.title: #016 The Prayers of Angels - Jimmy Akin
episodes.short: #016 The Prayers of Angels - Jimmy Akin
episodes.description: The idea of asking saints and angels for intercession, often thought of as unique to Catholicism and Orthodoxy, actually has roots predating the Christian era, as explained by Jimmy Akin.

episodes.title: #015 No Room in the Inn - Jimmy Akin
episodes.short: #015 No Room in the Inn - Jimmy Akin
episodes.description: Our view of the first Christmas is shaped by art and tradition, and a common idea about it may be incorrect. Find out why on the Jimmy Akin podcast.

episodes.title: #014 Mary Was Absolutely Sinless! - Jimmy Akin
episodes.short: #014 Mary Was Absolutely Sinless! - Jimmy Akin
episodes.description: What happens when someone who’s new to the Faith thinks he understands a complex, technical matter and then tries to publicly shame someone who’s much more experienced? Let’s find out!

episodes.title: #013 Jesus Cleansing the Temple—Why and When? - Jimmy Akin
episodes.short: #013 Jesus Cleansing the Temple—Why and When? - Jimmy Akin
episodes.description: All four Gospels record the fact that Jesus cleared the temple in Jerusalem of buyers and sellers. Why did he do this? What’s more, when did he do this? Matthew, Mark, and Luke record him doing it at the end of his ministry, but John records him doing it at the beginning. In this episode, Jimmy Akin takes you through the biblical clues needed to understand this mysterious event!

episodes.title: #012 Is Everything Predestined? - Jimmy Akin
episodes.short: #012 Is Everything Predestined? - Jimmy Akin
episodes.description: Jimmy explores the controversial topic of predestination, examining Calvinist claims that God predestines all events, while challenging the biblical evidence often cited to support these views.

episodes.title: #011 Arguments from Silence - Jimmy Akin
episodes.short: #011 Arguments from Silence - Jimmy Akin
episodes.description: In this episode, Jimmy reveals why arguments from silence are so problematic and why the arguments used to support claims from skeptics just don’t work.

episodes.title: #010 James White’s Gish Gallop (Debater’s Tactic) - Jimmy Akin
episodes.short: #010 James White’s Gish Gallop (Debater’s Tactic) - Jimmy Akin
episodes.description: Jimmy looks at an unethical debater’s tactic known as the Gish Gallop, and how Protestant debater James White regularly uses it when he confronts other viewpoints.

episodes.title: #009 Do We Leave Time When We Die? - Jimmy Akin
episodes.short: #009 Do We Leave Time When We Die? - Jimmy Akin
episodes.description: Do our souls leave time when we die and go to be with God in heaven? And—if we are outside of time—are we already saints in heaven, right now? Prepare for some surprises!

episodes.title: #008 Reconstructed Dialogue in the Bible - Jimmy Akin
episodes.short: #008 Reconstructed Dialogue in the Bible - Jimmy Akin
episodes.description: Jimmy Akin shows what the ancient audiences actually believed about the way the Gospels convey truth, and it isn’t as simple as modern audiences assume.

episodes.title: #007 The Jonah Death Hypothesis (Did Jonah Die in the Whale?)
episodes.short: #007 The Jonah Death Hypothesis (Did Jonah Die in the Whale?)
episodes.description: Recently, some people have been claiming that the prophet Jonah actually died in the whale and then rose from the dead. But did he?
